item.title: Cuban Sundays at The Dark Horse Stables — Sun Aug 9, 4:00 PM — The Dark Horse Camden
item.description:
Get ready for Cuban Sundays at The Dark Horse Stables! We’re turning up the heat with two amazing rooms full of dancing, music, and good vib
Get ready for Cuban Sundays at The Dark Horse Stables! We’re turning up the heat with two amazing rooms full of dancing, music, and good vibes! Left Room 💃 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM: Dance it out with the amazing Maikel Mota 🎶 6:00 PM – 11:00 PM: Feel the groove as DJ Petit spins the best of Kizomba Right Room 🔥 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM: Keep the party going all night with DJ Ricafed and Johnny Gee Plus, everyone joining the event gets a special discount to dine at any restaurant in The Dark Horse. Come dance, eat, and celebrate Cuban style!
Source: Go Latin Dance

item.title: Sunday Salsa Bachata at the Rose — Sun Aug 9, 5:00 PM — The Rose – New York
item.description:
Come join us at The Rose every Sunday for our Latin night and dancing! There will be an open level dance class (often a little footwork and then partner work in either salsa or bachata), and then a social party after. There is a bar available to purchase drinks.
Source: Go Latin Dance

item.title: Salsa Bachata Social at Dovercourt — Sun Aug 9, 5:30 PM — Dovercourt House
item.description:
Join us each and every Sunday at Dovercourt House, where we are giving you the best of Salsa y Bachata. Date and Time: Sunday 5:30pm to 11pm Dance Lessons at 6pm Multi Levels Salsa Lessons at 6pm by UnitedSalseros (beginner, Intermediate, Advance) Kizomba Lesson by Babs and Nyemu at 7pm Social Dancing: 3 Rooms, 3 DJs Salsa Music by DJ Timber (First Floor) 7pm – 11pm Bachata Music by DJ Mondo (3rd Floor) 7pm – 11pm Kizomba Lesson by DJ Amano (2nd floor) 8pm – 11pm Cover – Fee: $15 ($5 discount with Friday unbroken wristband or otherwise pre-register on Friday) Address: 805 Dovercourt Rd., Toronto (walking distance from Ossington Subway Station) — 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐭 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐏𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 — You can park on Dovercourt Rd until Midnight, you can park on Bloor st after midnight without restriction. There are couple of Paid parking spaces near our venue: 1022 Bloor St W 1048 Bloor St W 9 Salem Ave (Green P) 7 Bartlett Ave (CarPark) 745 Ossington Ave (Green P)
Source: Go Latin Dance

item.title: Sunday Social Dance — Sun Aug 9, 6:30 PM — Galaxy Dance Club
item.description:
Join us for an unforgettable evening of dance! Start your night with energizing salsa and bachata classes that will get your feet moving and your heart racing. After the classes, enjoy a lively social where you can show off your new moves! Dance the night away to a mix of salsa, bachata, cha cha, and kizomba music. Whether you’re a seasoned dancer or just starting out, our welcoming atmosphere is perfect for everyone. Come for the dance, stay for the fun! Entry $15 Salsa & Bachata classes 6:30 – 7:30pm Social 7:30pm – 10:30pm Rotating guest DJs playing Salsa, Bachata, Merengue, Cha Cha and Kizomba
Source: Go Latin Dance

Try New Things in Toronto! # 🌿🌅 NORTH SCARBOROUGH EVENING TRAILS & DINNER AT REMEZZO 🍝✨
**Hidden Green Spaces, Summer Evenings & One of Scarborough's Favourite Italian Restaurants**
Looking for a relaxing way to spend a summer evening? Join us as we explore a series of hidden trails and parks in North Scarborough. I've connected several local pathways to create one continuous walk that feels surprisingly peaceful, even though we're surrounded by the city.
This is an easy walk with very few hills, making it perfect for anyone who wants to get outside, enjoy some fresh air, and meet new people after work.
After approximately **90 minutes** of walking, we'll finish the evening with an optional dinner at **Remezzo Italian Bistro**, a Scarborough favourite that's been serving classic Italian food since 1978. After all, the walk is only part of the experience—the conversations over dinner are often where friendships begin.
